Results.ReviewText:
The grill works great (as we would expect from Weber-Great quality, lasts for years-we never purchase any other brand!).  HOWEVER, with the shorter lids on your grills now we’re no longer able to cook beer/soda can chicken as there isn’t enough room between the grates and the lid.  With beer/soda can chicken being such a staple in our house-we cook a few a month-we’re so disappointed!

I've had this grill for 1.5 mos and extremely happy with the results.The learning curve was quick. I've cooked burgers, dogs, salmon, chicken and pork and it's some of the best grilled foods I've tasted. I know it will only get better as I explore cooking with my Weber.

I remember seeing a cooking demonstration 40 years ago where a turkey was cooked on a kettle and the turkey was great. My next purchase will be a 22" Kettle to go next to my Spirit II E-210, this way I can have the best of both worlds. 

Don't know why I waited so long to go with Weber but I'm happy I did. Thank you

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was disappointed at first as I was expecting the earlier version with the enclosed base.  After consideration I realized that the open base and side mounted tank was a better idea. Assembly was easy but the directions were a little vague.  I found that certain steps were better performed out of order in order to access some fasteners. Once assembled, I was surprised how sturdy it is.  The grill body and drip pan are designed for easy clean up - love that.  Now let's get cooking.  The grilling surface heats uniformly and properly seasoned the grates are almost stick free.  The flavor bars prevent uncontrollable flare ups and produce great smoky flavor from the grease drippings.  The burner controls are very affective in maintaining desired temperature.  The negative aspect for me is the stainless steel side trays and control face.  I would have preferred something easier to clean.
Results.Title: Nice Compact Grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
